summary: All 24 target episodes promoted to exact per-episode records; nothing left zone-level. The nanatsu-no-taizai fandom wiki carries a per-episode |chapters field for every target, the chapter pages carry the reverse |episodes map (walked chs 101-146, 197/219/225, 243-249, 268-296, 327, SS3/SS5 — it interlocks with the episode-side lists with one minor discrepancy on ch 285), and animefillerguide's nanatsu-no-taizai table agrees exactly on all 24 episodes. Official chapter-title == episode-title matches (ep30=112 'Existence & Proof', ep31=116, ep32=119, ep33 opens 120 'Overwhelming Violence', ep34=123, ep35=126, ep37=131, ep38=132, ep41=146 'Farewell, Beloved Thief', ep69=248 'Our Choices', ep77 opens 268 'From Purgatory', ep83=294 'Hope, Discord and Despair', ep84 contains 284 'The Door to Hope', ep94 = SS5 'The King Sings in Loneliness') independently pin most zone boundaries. Confirmed: ch 101 is in neither S2-opener episode (its content was folded into S1 ep 24's altered ending), ep 53 is exactly 197+219+225, ep 69/70 split is 243+246-248 vs 244-245+247-249, and the Purgatory interleave resolves scene-block by scene-block with ep 85's stored record. AFG may share lineage with fandom, so pure-interior episodes with no independent third line (39, 40, 78-81) are marked medium.

flags_for_sean: ep 24 (not a target, no repair made): stored anchor is end=100, but AFG lists ep 24 as chs 98-103 + 108 and the fandom chapter pages tag 101, 102, 103, 108, 109 with episode 24 / Signs of Holy War — i.e. the S1 finale's altered ending consumed bits of 101-103/108, and ch 101 ('The Power of Love') is never adapted anywhere else (S2 opener starts at 102, confirming the batch-8 'ch 101 in neither episode' note). Keeping end=100 remains the sane position instrument because eps 29-30 re-adapt 102-112 properly, but if you want ep 24's record literal, its honest list is ~98-103+108 with continue→101.

ch 285 minor source discrepancy: the Dragon's Judgement Episode 1 page and AFG both list 285 in ep 77, but Chapter 285's own page tags only WoTG24 (ep 76, matching the stored ep76 'jumps to 272/285 material' annotation). Kept 285 in ep 77's list per the two episode-side sources — it evidently spans both.

Continue-point convention used inside the two interleave zones (33-41, 77-84): continue = lowest chapter that still has unadapted mainline content, except the recurring flashback-frame fragments of ch 272 (spread over eps 76/80/83/84) which are ignored for frontier purposes; each such choice is spelled out in the note.

Confidence calibration: animefillerguide's table matches the fandom episode pages verbatim for all 24 targets, so per the shared-lineage caveat episodes whose split has no independent third line (39, 40, 78, 79, 80, 81) are marked medium even though three surfaces (episode pages, chapter-page reverse map, AFG) agree exactly; every other target has an official chapter-title/episode-title match, a MAL-thread corroboration, or a stored-anchor interlock on top.
